Experience writing requirements and drafting Statement of Work (SOW) and Technical Instruction.
Ability to review and develop project work, quantities, costs, accuracy of specifications, completeness, and constructability.
Sound oral and written communications skills.
Ability to work efficiently with limited or no supervision.
The ability to travel 10% of the time.

Familiarization with the NAVSEA Organization and its field activities.
Experience working with US Navy and Commercial ship and ship system design principles and practices.
